Nestimate: Dynamic, Probabilistic, and Higher-Order Network Analysis

Source: R/Nestimate-package.R
Nestimate-package.Rd

Nestimate estimates networks from sequences, event logs, one-hot codes and panel data, compares them, and tests how far they can be trusted. One entry point, build_network(), estimates transition networks (transition probabilities, frequencies, co-occurrence and attention-weighted transitions; Saqr et al. 2025, doi:10.1145/3706468.3706513 ) and psychological networks (correlation, partial correlation, graphical lasso and Ising models, Saqr, Beck and López-Pernas 2024, doi:10.1007/978-3-031-54464-4_19 ; and mixed graphical models), and returns a netobject. The other verbs, by the question they answer (most read a netobject; the panel-data ones read the data directly):

  • inference on a network: bootstrap_network(), boot_glasso(), split-half reliability with network_reliability() and centrality stability with centrality_stability();

  • comparison of networks: compare_networks(), and the permutation tests permutation() and nct();

  • the structure of a network: net_centrality(), chain_structure(), passage_time(), markov_stability(), stability_landscape() and transition_entropy();

  • subgroups: clustering with build_clusters(), mixed Markov models with build_mmm() and multi-cluster multi-layer networks with build_mcml();

  • higher-order networks: build_hon(), higher-order network embedding with build_honem(), hyper-path anomalies with build_hypa(), the multi-order generative model build_mogen(), and markov_order_test();

  • panel data: multilevel vector autoregression with build_mlvar() and person-specific networks with build_gimme().

References

Saqr, M., López-Pernas, S., Törmänen, T., Kaliisa, R., Misiejuk, K., & Tikka, S. (2025). Transition network analysis: A novel framework for modeling, visualizing, and identifying the temporal patterns of learners and learning processes. In Proceedings of the 15th International Learning Analytics and Knowledge Conference (LAK25). ACM. doi:10.1145/3706468.3706513

Saqr, M., Beck, E., & López-Pernas, S. (2024). Psychological networks: A modern approach to analysis of learning and complex learning processes. In M. Saqr & S. López-Pernas (Eds.), Learning Analytics Methods and Tutorials: A Practical Guide Using R. Springer. doi:10.1007/978-3-031-54464-4_19
